related_questions.question: How many days should I get tested for COVID after exposure?

text_blocks.snippet: If you've been exposed to someone with COVID-19 but have no symptoms, you should wait at least 5 full days after exposure before testing. If you develop symptoms, test immediately. For those without symptoms, consider repeat testing with multiple tests over a few days, testing at least twice over three days if symptomatic and at least three times over five days if asymptomatic.
